text:
Lucas Wetherby captained the yacht Seren Aduial in the Pallister Cup, according to the official crew declaration filed for the race.

The Pallister Cup Official Crew Declaration Form (Race Ref. PC-23/09), held at the Harrowmere Yacht Club registry, lists Mr Wetherby as skipper. Marguerite Ostrander, Race Director of the Pallister Cup Committee, verified the crew declarations. Mr Wetherby was confirmed at the helm on 14 September 2023, the final race day.

Seren Aduial completed the 212-nautical-mile course in 31 hours 47 minutes. That placed her third among 18 entries.

The registry filing is the document on which the committee relied in confirming the vessel's command. It names Mr Wetherby as the person responsible for the yacht throughout the event, and no competing declaration was recorded for Seren Aduial.
